name: @red-cup-engineering/coinbase-bazaar-service
description: Read-only client for Coinbase's x402 Bazaar catalog: page the directory, determine whether our own resources are listed (three-valued, so an unread catalog never reads as an absent listing), and reduce the published per-resource quality data into demand evidence — unique payers, price distribution, and category demand. Zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
